data.description: Found in KYS judge-path QA (Aditya + Claude), local run 2026-08-11. Two public doors misdirect: 'View public CFP' on the landing went to /submissions (organizer admin, a sign-in wall for a signed-out judge) instead of the public form at /f/cfp; and the public agenda header's 'Organizer demo' points at /submissions?demo=organizer, which performs no auth outside the landing page (nothing in src reads ?demo=), so a signed-out visitor lands on the 401 screen. Fix in the linked branch: the CFP door opens /f/cfp; the agenda's demo door opens / (the landing, where the demo buttons actually authenticate). The speaker door's 403 dead end was fixed upstream in parallel (landing now sends it to /portal?demo=speaker) and is not part of this change.
data.title: Landing and public-agenda demo doors point at the wrong rooms

data.body:
Closing as already fixed on github/main — verified at 16c9f82c, not by re-reading the branch but by reading the shipped source.

Both doors are correct today:
- Landing 'View public CFP' -> /f/cfp (src/routes/landing.route.tsx:181).
- Public agenda header 'Organizer demo' -> / (src/ui/public/agenda/PublicAgendaPage.tsx:213), which is the landing page where the demo buttons actually authenticate.

The linked branch fix-landing-door-destinations is stale: its four commits are behind main in every file they touch (it predates the reviewer demo door and the cold start), so the fixes reached main through other work rather than through that branch. Nothing on it needs merging.

Residual, deliberately not fixed here: the landing's demo buttons still carry href=/submissions?demo=organizer as their no-JS fallback, and ?demo= is read by nothing in src. That only bites a visitor whose JS failed, and MRQ-133 gives that case a real destination (the 401 wall plus /signin). MRQ-133 also requires the demo landing to stay byte-identical tonight, so the fallback hrefs stay as they are.

Branch fix-landing-door-destinations deleted from GitHub on operator instruction, 2026-08-12. Its PR (#24, 'KYS-1/KYS-2: the public CFP door opens the public form, plus one filed finding') was already closed unmerged.

Recoverable: tip was 81f95d70, authored by Aditya Advani 2026-08-11 16:12 -0700. The only thing on it that never reached main is the board record for KYS-3 (task_01KZSG0GFVPAG46QPTEJEH6PB9, the local-uploads finding) — the capability itself shipped on main as LOCAL_UPLOAD_SHIM plus /api/v1/uploads/local/{id}, so what was lost is a ticket file, not work.
